items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: Drag-and-drop kanban board (KanbanBoard, KanbanColumn, KanbanCard) on dnd-kit: controlled columns with onChange, WIP limit warning, empty state, add-button slot, one drag handle per card, pointer, touch and keyboard dragging, Korean screen-reader announcements.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Card, column and handle ids must be unique across the board. Keyboard: Space/Enter lift, arrows move (focus stays on the lifted card's handle), Space drop, Esc cancel. v4: own edge autoscroll (48 px zone) on the board and the hovered list (dnd-kit autoScroll is off); the board keeps its start height during a drag; WIP overflow no longer adds a row (count turns alert with a triangle glyph, 2 px inset top rule, status text is screen-reader only); insertion marker is a 2 px line with 4x4 caps; empty columns show "여기에 놓기" while a card is held (`dropText`); over-limit target ring flickers once; `collapsible` adds a per-column toggle. MIGRATION v4: the visible WIP banner row is gone (style hooks on `p[role=status]` now hit a visually hidden node); `@/lib/fx` and `@yorha/glyph` are now dependencies. Set lang="ko" on the wrapper; announcements are Korean.
